Name: SDV-Radiance
Author: PHUICMT
Description:
[center][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/49397/49397-1791090240-1622644431.jpg[/img]

[size=4][b]Shadows, water, light and weather for Stardew Valley.[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]It works on top of whatever your game already draws, so recolours, custom sprites and map mods just work. Every effect can be turned off on its own.[/color]

[color=#D4D4D8][b]Needs[/b] SMAPI · [b]Optional[/b] Generic Mod Config Menu · [b]Runs on[/b] PC and Android
[b]Safe[/b] to add or remove mid-save · [b]F6[/b] opens the settings[/color]

[color=#D4D4D8]Clips of every effect and what's coming next: [url=https://radiance.phu-space.com]radiance.phu-space.com[/url][/color]

[color=#D4D4D8]Since 2.3.1 your settings are kept through updates, even with Vortex. If you're updating from 2.3.0 or older, copy your config.json first, or press [b]Copy everything[/b] under Looks in F6 and save the code.[/color][/center]

[list]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]2.4.2:[/b] hide the settings you don't use in F6 (Show again brings them back), a menu that moves, Menu density and Text size, search in every language, and the fishing meter no longer shows in the water.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]2.4.1:[/b] hotfix for the new F6 menu: Classic no longer leaves the menu stuck, search types right in the box at the top, and Thai text fits.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]2.4.0:[/b] a new F6 menu on frosted glass, grouped by what you see, with search (Classic brings back the old tabs). [/list][color=#D4D4D8]Older versions are on the Changelogs tab.[/color]

[img]https://phuicmt.github.io/SDV-Radiance-media/banners/install.png[/img]
[color=#D4D4D8][b]1.[/b] Install [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url].
[b]2.[/b] Unzip into your [font=Courier New]Mods[/font] folder. [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] is optional.
[b]3.[/b] Press [b]F6[/b] in game to change settings. On a phone, open it from the config menu: SDV-Radiance, Hotkeys & diagnostics, Open the Radiance tuner.[/color]

[img]https://phuicmt.github.io/SDV-Radiance-media/banners/make-it-yours.png[/img]
[color=#D4D4D8]F6 opens the settings over the game, and you see every change right away. Settings are grouped by what you see (Light & shadow, Water, Weather & sky and so on) on a frosted glass panel, the search box at the top finds any of them, and a bar under the list shows the game without and with most effects. [b]Classic[/b] at the top brings back the old tabs in the wooden box. Start from a preset (Subtle, Cinematic, Vibrant or Nocturne), save your own, share yours as a code, or try a look another mod offers under [b]Looks from your mods[/b]. Settings that start off say in their help what I suggest.

Making a look for your own mod or collection? [url=https://github.com/PHUICMT/SDV-Radiance/blob/main/docs/look-packs.md]Here's how to offer it[/url] without writing over anyone's settings.[/color]

[color=#D4D4D8][b]What's on after install[/b][/color]
[spoiler]
[list]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]On:[/b] sun and lamp shadows, water and reflections, flowing rivers, window light and glow, lamp halos, wind in the trees, crops and grass, aurora and shooting stars, sun shafts, cloud shadows, rain and snow, weather particles, screen raindrops, bloom.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]Off until you turn it on:[/b] Smooth art, sprite relief, golden hour, day fog, wet ground, lamps on dry ground, lightning through windows, whirlwinds, tumbleweeds, lamp shafts, the smooth camera, colour grading, effects in map screenshots.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]Choices that start on the old look:[/b] Window light (As before, or From the glass), Window detail (Whole window, or Keep detail) and Leaf look (Realistic, or Pixel).[/color][/*]
[/list][/spoiler]

[img]https://phuicmt.github.io/SDV-Radiance-media/banners/everything.png[/img]
[color=#D4D4D8][b]Light and shadows[/b][/color]
[spoiler]
[list]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]Sun shadows[/b] that follow the time of day, moon shadows at night, and [b]lamp shadows[/b] from torches, lanterns and fireplaces.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]Shadow colour:[/b] blue on clear days, grey in rain, warm indoors. Sharp near the feet, softer further out.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]A soft dark spot under people and animals[/b], so nobody looks like they're floating at noon.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]Sun direction[/b] can be changed, and the player, villagers, farm animals and other creatures each have their own shadow switch.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]Bounced light[/b] that walls block, so rooms get some depth.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]Windows glow at night and let daylight onto the floor[/b], based on the hour, season and weather. Sunlight comes through the greenhouse roof too.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]Night lights:[/b] lit windows brighten the street, lamps get a soft halo, embers and fireflies light what's near them, and a fish tank throws moving light on the walls.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]Light from the glass[/b] (Window light: From the glass): only the glass glows, so bars and frames stay visible, the light on the floor keeps the shape of the panes, and light rays hang in the air under the window. A sheer curtain lets some light through in its own colour. It knows the game's windows, Stardew Valley Expanded's and those of 97 furniture and map mods, each checked by hand.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]Keep detail[/b] (Window detail) stops a window with bars, a frame or curtains painted in from turning into a white block at midday.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]Windows reflect[/b] whoever stands in front of them, and turn into mirrors of the room at night. The bus windows and the bath house mirrors reflect too. A TV that's on lights the room.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]Lightning[/b] flashes the scene and throws shadows. With [b]Lightning through windows[/b] (off by default) the windows flash indoors too, and a near strike throws a beam into the room.[/color][/*]
[/list][/spoiler]
[color=#D4D4D8][b]Water[/b][/color]
[spoiler]
[list]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]Two water styles:[/b] Water 1.6 or the older Water 1.5 with its three looks.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]Reflections that follow the real shoreline.[/b] You, trees, crab pots, splashes and your bobber all reflect.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]Water reacts to things:[/b] wind ruffles it, clouds dim the sparkle, ducks and casts leave rings, and fish spots bubble.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]Rivers flow[/b] into a waterfall above it and away from it below, faster near the fall, with foam on the current. The sea has its own waves.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]Light patterns on shallow water[/b] and rain rings on the surface. Ponds, sea and ice each look different.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]Works with modded water[/b], from what the game draws plus hand-made labels. Ice, waterfalls and lava are handled too.[/color][/*]
[/list][/spoiler]
[color=#D4D4D8][b]Weather, particles and colour[/b][/color]
[spoiler]
[list]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]Rain, snow and blowing leaves[/b] with splashes, adjustable rain amount and angle, and lightning you can see on any map. Leaves on the wind come in the mod's smooth shapes or the game's own pixel art.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]Wet ground[/b] (off by default): stone and dirt darken and hold puddles, grass and sand soak up the rain, and ground under a roof stays dry. Puddles mirror what stands behind them and take rain rings, and at night lamps lay streaks of light across the wet street. Realistic or Pixel, and no puddles on snow.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]Whirlwinds and tumbleweeds[/b] (off by default): whirlwinds carry leaves and dust in storms and on windy days, or sand in the desert, and tumbleweeds roll across open sand.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]The day before rain[/b] gets more clouds and cooler light. Crops sway with the trees, and snow sparkles in the sun.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]Raindrops on the screen[/b] that run down the edges, and frost when it snows.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]Particles:[/b] dust in window light, sparks from fires, fireflies, waterfall mist, hot spring steam, lava sparks, and leaves floating on the water.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]Small details:[/b] dust under your feet on dry ground, heat shimmer over chimneys and Clint's forge, mist in foggy mine levels, rainbows in waterfall spray, sparkles on watered soil.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]Sun shafts[/b] through the trees, on by default. Lamp shafts are off by default.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]Colour grading[/b] by time, weather and season, with six presets and room for your own LUT. Off by default. There's a blue light filter too.[/color][/*]
[/list][/spoiler]
[color=#D4D4D8][b]More[/b][/color]
[spoiler]
[list]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]Wind in the trees.[/b] Trees and bushes lean with the wind, more in a storm, barely on a calm day.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]Aurora[/b] on clear winter nights, also in the sea, and [b]shooting stars[/b] over the water. Both are rare.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]Shadow shapes:[/b] fences, bushes and rocks cast their real shape in lamp light. Pick Shadows 1.7 or Shadows 1.6 for how shadows lie on the ground.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]Bloom[/b] that makes coloured lights glow without making snow glow.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]Smooth art[/b] rounds off the pixel steps on diagonal edges, using only the colours already in the art. Off by default. World, characters, portraits, items and menus each have their own switch.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]Sprite relief[/b] lights the side of trees, buildings and people that faces a lamp, with a rim light at night. Off by default.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]Golden hour[/b] warms the light around sunset. Off by default.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Settings that can't do anything right now are hidden, so the menu stays short.[/color][/*]
[/list][/spoiler]

[img]https://phuicmt.github.io/SDV-Radiance-media/banners/good-to-know.png[/img]
[color=#D4D4D8][b]Performance.[/b] How much it costs depends on your machine. Every effect has a switch, and [font=Courier New]radiance_report[/font] shows what each part costs on yours.[/color]
[spoiler]
[color=#D4D4D8]I test on one PC (Core Ultra 7, RTX 5080, 3440x1369, zoom 0.75), so any speed numbers I give are from my machine and may not match yours.

[b]If it runs slow:[/b] the search box at the top of F6 finds every setting named here. Under Performance, try the Performance or Low spec preset, and keep [b]Lower it automatically when needed[/b] on (new installs have it on). It lowers the effect resolution only while the game can't keep up, and on a slow card it saves more than anything else. Lighter soft effects is on by default and kicks in first. After that, set [b]Shadow detail[/b] under Lamp shadow detail to 0, then turn off [b]Trees & bushes too[/b] under What casts a shadow. Turning Flood GI lighting off isn't a saving on a slow card: on my machine the classic lighting it switches to was no cheaper anywhere and slower indoors.[/color]
[/spoiler]
[color=#D4D4D8][b]Compatibility[/b][/color]
[spoiler]
[list]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]Recolours and art mods just work[/b], since everything comes from what's on screen. Tested with SVE and big mod lists.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]Cloudy Skies and Weather Wonders:[/b] on days they draw their own weather, Radiance steps aside. On normal rain and snow days, Radiance's rain and snow show.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]Map screenshots[/b] (the game's Screenshot button, Daily Screenshot) save the normal picture, or the picture with effects if you turn on [b]Effects in map screenshots[/b] under Camera in F6.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]Mods that move the sunset[/b], such as Dynamic Dusk: the lit windows, night mist and night glow start with the game's own dusk, so they follow.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/50971]UltraSmooth[/url]:[/b] works together, high refresh modes included. Its author added support for Radiance, so the lighting and particles keep their normal speed.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]Global God Rays:[/b] works together. They do similar things, so turn one down or use either.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]Multiplayer and split screen:[/b] only you need it installed. Other players get shadows and reflections too.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]SpriteMaster or Clear Glasses:[/b] pick one. Smooth art turns itself off next to them, but shadows and water can still flicker with Clear Glasses. Clear Monocle and DynamicShader work fine. With ReShade or another shader mod the effects stack, so turn one down.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]Android:[/b] works through SMAPI for Android. Phones start on the Low spec preset.[/color][/*]
[/list][/spoiler]
[color=#D4D4D8][b]Known issues[/b][/color]
[spoiler]
[list]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Map screenshots with effects don't include moving particles yet (waterfall mist, leaves, fireflies, dust).[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]A shadow can fall across a table or counter instead of stopping at it.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Some modded glass doesn't reflect yet, and From the glass only knows windows I've checked by hand (any other window keeps the old light). A screenshot, the mod's name and the location is all I need.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Water under some modded bridges may look wrong, depending on how the map built the bridge. A [font=Courier New]radiance_report[/font] from on the bridge helps.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Online co-op has had less testing than split screen.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Smooth art uses extra video memory. If your card is low on memory, turn it off.[/color][/*]
[/list][/spoiler]
[color=#D4D4D8][b]FAQ[/b][/color]
[spoiler]
[list]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]Safe to uninstall?[/b] Yes. It doesn't touch your save, and it doesn't connect to the internet.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]I updated and nothing changed.[/b] Your settings are kept on purpose, and new effects start off. Their help in F6 says what I suggest. Pick a preset in F6, or delete [font=Courier New]config.json[/font] to get the new defaults.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]I can't find a setting.[/b] Type part of its name in the search box at the top of F6. It works in both layouts and says where the setting lives.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]Something looks wrong with another mod?[/b] Post on the Bugs tab with a [url=https://smapi.io/log]SMAPI log[/url], a screenshot, and the file [font=Courier New]radiance_report[/font] makes while you stand in that spot.[/color][/*]
[/list][/spoiler]
[color=#D4D4D8][b]What I'm working on next[/b][/color]
[spoiler]
[list]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Getting along with Clear Glasses and similar mods.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Better speed, especially on big modded farms and slower PCs.[/color][/*]
[/list][/spoiler]

Downloads.Description: Too many settings? Hide the ones you don't use in F6 and bring them back any time. The new menu also moves, has density and text size choices, and search finds settings in any language. Fixed the fishing meter showing in the water.

Manifest.Name: SDV-Radiance
Manifest.Description: Shadows, water, light and weather for Stardew Valley: sun and lamp shadows, water and window reflections, rain and snow, wind in the trees, bloom and more. Every effect can be turned off on its own. Press F6 to change settings.
